overview: Topical debate in which guests from the worlds of politics and the media answer questions posed by members of the public.
title: Question Time

overview: "Ka $ ta" - it is serialiti that has no analogues on Ukrainian television. There is not scenario in the classic sense of the word: all story moves dictated by life itself, and the characters and stories have no idea who surprises await them in the next series. The protagonists of ''Ka$ta " are brightest representatives of the" golden youth " of Kyiv: Dmitro Stupka actor and his friend Olexy Kostylev, singer Masha Fokina, entrepreneur Valery Sozanovsky, a member of the group ''D.Lemma'' Zhenya Bardachenko, scandalous secular party girl Aliona Loran and Carolina Ruffo , actress Memetova Leila and Victoria Tokmanenko, business Myanovsky Andrew, Georgy Zubko and Constantine Moroz, model Holynyak Vitaliy and Tatyana Pop, beauties Natalya Bader and Tatyana Laktionova. Thanks serialiti "Ka $ and" personal secrets, relationships and lives of these people will become available across the country - in the project they play themselves, and the plot is completely based on real events of their lives.
title: Каста

overview: Arriving late for her first day working at the Bokuto Police Department, the hotheaded Natsumi Tsujimoto feels uneasy about working with her new partner, the comparatively stiff Miyuki Kobayakawa. However, after learning that underneath Miyuki's rule-following exterior is a savvy mechanic who is extremely skilled behind the wheel of her heavily modified patrol car, Natsumi finds that her partner may be exactly what she needs. From apprehending reckless street racers to protecting their community, the two young women serve their city with tremendous energy and form a bond that extends far beyond their workplace. This is original OVA series and not time-constrained. TV series later are continuation of this story, though first four episodes are edited versions of these OVA episodes.
title: Taiho Shichau zo

overview: Cake or fake? Trick or treat? Skilled bakers whip up hyperrealistic Halloween cakes in this seasonal special edition of the hit competition series.
title: Is It Cake? Halloween

overview: Best friends and partners Miyuki Kobayakawa and Natsumi Sujimoto, along with the rest of the gang at Bokuto station, confront a motley group of offenders ranging from hi-tech panty thieves, purse-snatchers, and traffic violators. Using Miyuki's driving prowess and tech knowledge, as well as Natsumi's spunk and strength, the duo at times must resort to unconventional methods to see that justice is served.
title: Taiho Shichau zo Special

overview: Vasily Baranov, who built a business abroad, falls under foreign sanctions and is suddenly deprived of everything. The news finds him in his native Semibolotsk, where he has not been for almost thirty years. Vasily turns to his family for support, but no one talks to him. Thinking that the reason lies in his sudden poverty, the former oligarch decides to get rich again in order to regain the respect of his father and ex-fiancee, and now the mayor's wife. Baranov's only ally — is a local taxi driver, whose wife, for some reason, is sharply against her husband's communication with the ex-billionaire.
title: Санкционер

overview: 18-year-old Odin disappears after a night out in Trondheim. A desperate search for answers begins when his belongings mysteriously turn up.
title: Hvor er Odin?

overview: Suho and Hyunseo, who once dated for six years, meet again as a youthful rich CEO and a piano instructor. K works with Suho on a collaborative project and invites Hyeonseo to join them. Suho and Hyunseo embark on a bumpy romantic journey full of twists and turns. Will history repeat itself?
title: Soundtrack #2

overview: Australians rarely pause to appreciate the miracle behind the ballot box. How often do we stop and marvel at what we've built? How many of us know that the familiar, uncontroversial features of our electoral system are – in global terms – highly unusual? And how many of us have heard the rollicking backstories of the democratic dreamers and reformed felons behind it? Across three episodes Annabel Crabb's Civic Duty unearths the individuals and stories that combine to make Australian democracy globally unique, like our invention of the secret ballot, our adoption of preferential and compulsory voting, and our peculiar attachment to sausages. Annabel travels both here and abroad to investigate how the politics of our parliament have changed thanks to political leaders, the media landscape – but most of all - the power of the Australian people.
title: Annabel Crabb's Civic Duty
Strange Chronicles of Tang: The Nine-Tiered Labyrinth

overview: Great Estates from Above is a series that uses cutting-edge drone and aerial photography to reveal Britain's most magnificent country houses and palaces from an entirely new perspective. Soaring over grand estates, the series captures their breathtaking architecture, formal gardens, and sweeping parklands in extraordinary detail, while uncovering rich histories and personal stories from the families and staff who care for them. With intimate interviews and mesmerizing visuals, this narrator-led journey offers a unique glimpse into these iconic landmarks, many made famous by series like Downton Abbey and Bridgerton, showcasing their timeless beauty and ongoing preservation efforts from a vantage point few have ever seen.
title: Great Estates from Above

overview: Fed up with excuses and failed campaigns, Tony Armstrong is on a mission to tackle racism in Australian sport. The former AFL player turned award-winning broadcaster embarks on a global search for solutions he hopes can drive systemic change to Australia's own major sporting codes. Through conversations with former athletes and sporting legends such as Sydney Swans' Adam Goodes and Manchester United and England captain Rio Ferdinand, by exploring the role of athlete activism, uncovering breakthrough AI technology that tracks online hate and challenging our major codes to take stronger action, Tony seeks to inspire meaningful change in tackling racism in sport. Tony's mission to create a better future for athletes at all levels won't happen overnight, but through athletes, institutions, and leadership, sport has the power to reshape Australia.
title: End Game with Tony Armstrong

overview: A limited series revealing how ordinary Germans planned to become Hitler's assassin and change history.
title: Killing Hitler

overview: Gingerbread Land: The Biggest Little Holiday Competition contestants transform flour, sugar, and candy into intricate works of art, competing in playful rounds that test design, structure, and creativity. Each week, new challenges bring twists and surprises, while Oliver Hudson guides the fun with warmth and humor, inviting viewers into a magical holiday world, where imagination has no limits.
title: Gingerbread Land: The Biggest Little Holiday Competition

overview: A wealthy, spoiled young woman moves from Los Angeles to Alaska, where she is forced to rent a cottage from three local men she considers below her social status.
title: The Last Frontier

overview: Discretion is a legal thriller about a summer associate Lenny at a prestigious Dallas law firm who uncovers a web of NDAs masking a dark truth. When she realizes she signed the same agreement, her discoveries put her in the crosshairs of the firm's most powerful female partner Sharon —upending their mentor-protégé dynamic and raising the question: who gets to keep secrets, and at what cost?
title: Discretion

overview: We have a deep sense of longing for the handmade. Perhaps because each of us, in our own way, has had a craft experience. Sometimes it's an object passed down to us, or one that crosses our path, and connects us to others in traditions, heritage, and rituals. Craft is all around us. You'll find it wherever you look – hiding in plain sight. Craft in America offers you a place to explore these connections and to inspire your own creativity. Join us on this voyage of discovery.
title: Craft in America

overview: Ravneet Gill's Chop House follows the culinary and entrepreneurial journey of Ravneet Gill and her husband Mattie, as they set out to open their own restaurant.
title: Ravneet Gill's Chop House

overview: Spinoff to Boku no Satsui ga Koi wo Shita.
title: Boku no Satsui ga Koisuru Mae

overview: Set in the present day, but with echoes of the Cold War, this spy thriller delves into the unknown world of "El Centro" - National Intelligence Center of the Spain (CNI). The plot begins with a murder that uncovers an international operation by the Russian intelligence services and leads the CNI members into a race against time to dismantle it, while also trying to uncover a traitor within their ranks.
title: El Centro

overview: Unicornland is an 8-episode webseries about Annie, who explores her sexuality post-divorce by dating couples. ...Over drinks, at dinner, and in bed. Each episode features a date with a new couple, from Williamsburg hipsters, to Wall Street power duos, to Bushwick burners, as Annie becomes not just sexually active, but activated. Unicornland was created/produced by Lucy Gillespie, directed by Nick Leavens, and shot by a 70% female cast and crew. Unicornland celebrates the ethnic and social diversity of New York City, with a cast that's 60% non-white, including trans, genderqueer and disabled actors. Unicornland contains themes of polyamory and open relationships, and was made with the full support of the New York sex positive community. In the final episode, Annie attends her first inclusive sex party at the Hacienda Villa, a renowned epicenter of the New York scene.
title: Unicornland

overview: It is a dramatic comedy series about a group of friends navigating the realities of being Black, queer, and polyamorous in New York City.
title: 195 Lewis

overview: The Alps – wild mountains, extreme lives, but also a magical world. This majestic mountain range connects eight countries and reaches heights of up to 4 000 metres above sea level. The so-called "Roof of Europe" continues to fascinate – across the continent and around the world. The incredible diversity of landscapes, flora and fauna makes the Alps a unique natural treasure at the heart of Europe. Enjoy the Alps in spring and summertime as newborn animals grow up to face the coming brutal winter. Experience the hostile and bitter cold ecosystems of the Alps, shaped by snow blizzards and avalanches.
title: Die Alpen

overview: A British comedy about an electronics expert who gets a job at MI5. His name is Peter Chapman - code name Piglet. Of course, he can never tell his wife what he really does for a living...
title: The Piglet Files

overview: "Lars and Lars" is a program series that follows the two fishing enthusiasts Lars Nilssen and Lars Lenth on their fishing trips, often in search of large trout and inspired by historical fishing descriptions, such as the book "Tre i Norge ved to av dem" from 1882. They travel to various places in Norway to experience fishing happiness and challenges related to fishing, as shown in the VGTV series, among others.
title: Lars og Lars

overview: Groapa presents a realistic and harsh picture of mafia life, family relationships, problems and love stories in a way that will make the people at home enjoy every second and understand that family is everything .
title: Groapa

overview: Impressive war machines from the Second World War to the current day, combining expert analysis and modern combat simulators to reveal their enduring legacy.
title: Iconic Combat Machines

overview: All aboard, this is your ticket to ride the most spectacular train journeys in Britain. To mark 200 years of British train travel in 2025, this series uses cutting-edge drones to showcase the most iconic steam train journeys in Britain, from above. In Scotland, the Jacobite Steam Train, better known as the Hogwarts Express, travels across the Scottish Highlands, unlocking the fascinating history of the Jacobite Rebellion. In Wales, the Mountain Spirit traverses glorious coastlines and ancient oak woodlands on the Ffestiniog Railway, through the mountainous Snowdonia National Park. And in England, the North Yorkshire Moors Railway travels from Whitby to Pickering, transporting us back in time to the golden age of steam train travel, and the West Somerset Railway scales rolling hills, to tell the story if its great engineer, Isambard Kingdom Brunel. In this spectacular series, immerse yourself in the romance, history and thrill of train travel.
title: Great British Train Journeys from Above

overview: Half a year before the occupation incident. Koichi struggles to discover the truth Kaiseido Hospital hides. Meanwhile, Koichi and Sagami infiltrate Tajima Design Office, which designed Kaiseido Hospital. They're looking for blueprint data, but suddenly three employees and a security guard show up. It seems that they were contacted by the police asking them to come because they wanted to hear about the theft. However, the elevator that everyone got on stops on the way. Furthermore, a mysterious gas blows out and consciousness is cut off. When they woke up, they heard a mysterious voice telling them that a black object had been wrapped around the necks of the employees, and that a poisonous injection had been placed in their collars. Amidst a sudden sense of urgency, the voice added: "If you want to get out of the elevator alive, find the killer inside."
title: Dai Byouin Senkyo Mae: The Night Before

overview: The story follows Koji, who is curious about Shishi, who has made Toru, who had never had any interest in romance, fall in love with him so much. One day, while working a part-time job, he bumps into Shishi, and although he says it's for his best friend Toru, he calls out to Shishi out of curiosity, and the two end up spending time together.
title: Tokyo Tower: Another Story

overview: Vivian Howard unpacks the secrets, shortcuts, and science behind everyday cooking.
title: Kitchen Curious

overview: César Bravo returns from Mexico, almost thirty years later, to the land of his birth, when no one remembers his father's last name or the tragic circumstances surrounding his death and that of his grandparents. Although his appearance as an adventurous tourist doesn't betray it, he is very clear about what he's coming for. He won't find peace until he achieves justice and puts Octavio Oramas in prison, the man who appropriated his father's family history and everything that belonged to him to create his own empire. What César doesn't count on is that on his path he will cross Amanda Oramas, the apple of his enemy's eye, with whom he will fall madly in love. A fortuitous crossroads that marks a before and after in the lives of two rival families. What will win: love or revenge?
title: La encrucijada

overview: In 1998, placebos of the best-selling contraceptive reached pharmacies, causing pregnancies and a scandal that affected many Brazilian women.
title: Pílula de Farinha: O Escândalo que Gerou Vidas

overview: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas. And because the holidays are a time for cooking with the ones you love, chefs will be invited to pair up in teams of two to compete for glory and goodwill. In every battle, teams will serve up a savory and a sweet dish based on the spin of the Randomizer. The chef teams will need to be in sync and on their game to earn the title, the belt, a $100,000 cash prize furnished by Carnival Cruise Lines and their split of an additional $50,000 prize to give to a cause close to their hearts.
title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas

overview: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars where fourteen of the most competitive and talented sweets makers are invited to the Yuletide Lodge for a competition unlike any other. While the competitors enter as individuals, their goal will be to get on-- and stay on-- the strongest team by any means necessary, because in this game the bakers must create incredible edible works of art to grow their teams and avoid elimination. In the end, teams will crumble until only the strongest will be left standing to become the Sweet Empire.
title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars

overview: The Antiques Riviera is a new six-part series for Channel 4's More4 that escapes to the beautiful south coast to discover what fortunes can be made for Brits with treasure to cash in. A honeypot for antique traders, this corner of Britain is a destination for buyers and sellers alike. This new series, produced in Glasgow by STV Studios Factual (Antiques Road Trip, The Yorkshire Auction House), brings this wonderful world to screen with a new format that follows a colourful cast of expert traders and local dealers. Each hour-long episode will welcome a new seller who is looking to turn their items into cash. By offering their heirlooms and antiques to dealers up and down the Devon coastline, the sellers hope they'll leave with as much money as possible to fund their dreams – whether that's a once-in-a-lifetime holiday, deposit for their first home, or even their wedding. Viewers will be treated to an escapist journey through the villages and towns of The Antiques Riviera, as our dealers reveal their tips and tricks to finding hidden valuables that could end up making a life-changing profit.
title: The Antiques Riviera

overview: Wonder is everywhere – if you know where to look. From sunny beaches to rugged moors, craggy munros to city streets, Hamza Yassin reveals amazing wildlife hidden around the UK.
title: Hamza's Hidden Wild Isles

overview: From the amazing views towards the Welsh mountains to the bucolic village byroads around Tarporley; Cheshire is like a picture- postcard. This four -part series showcases the charms of Cheshire through some of the county's proud residents as they live, work and play in the beautiful county they call home. From traditional cheese makers to the famous zoo we follow the locals as the county pops with wonderful Autumn colour. Exploring the county's industrial and artisanal past, this series reveals a deep history that the residents of Cheshire are proud to be a part of.
title: Britain's Most Scenic Counties: Cheshire

overview: The podcast "Dangerous Liaisons" is a new, candid project on the CHE! TV channel, where host Dmitry Rybin and psychologist Dmitry Gukhman talk to people tired of their own infidelity. Their faces are hidden, and their voices are disguised. However, the characters share a goal: to stop. Will the participants be able to uncover the true reasons for their unacceptable behavior and reveal their true colors?
title: Подкаст «Опасные связи»

overview: Wild About Animals is a documentary television series about a guide to the world of animals. The series is hosted by Mariette Hartley.
title: Wild About Animals

overview: For the sake of his first love, Zhou Mingrui makes the drastic decision to drop out. Together with his buddies Xu Jiaming and Pan Bowen, he chases their shared dream of creating a game. Starting from scratch, the trio battles a lack of funds, technical hurdles, and market skepticism, working tirelessly to perfect their creation. These three ordinary dreamers, supporting each other against all odds, ultimately find their path to success.
title: The Age of Passion

overview: A bizarre escape begins with two people—a hostage and a kidnapper. The only daughter of a major corporation is kidnapped, but the plan fails. As the young kidnapper stands still, stunned, the hostage begs him, "Please, run away with me!" As the chasers close in, they become increasingly encircled. Friends and enemies switch sides. What is she running from? What is the hidden secret? With the kidnapping as the catalyst, the gears of destiny start to turn. Where will the two of them end up? This thrilling, nonstop human suspense story is sure to shake your soul.
title: ESCAPE

overview: When Jughead's beloved pet Hot Dog is killed, he turns to Sabrina the Teenage Witch to bring him back with dark magic. While she succeeds, Hot Dog comes back changed and spreads a zombie plague that forces Archie and his friends to fight for survival and escape the now-infected Riverdale.
title: Afterlife with Archie

overview: This epic historical series, set at the beginning of the 14th century, focuses on the life of Orhan, son of Osman I and the second ruler of the Ottoman Empire—the man who transformed a small frontier Turkmen principality into a great empire that expanded into Europe and dominated much of the world for centuries.
title: Kuruluş: Orhan

overview: Representatives of the older generation of the family, Vladimir and Marina, have already fulfilled their parental duty and sent daughter Ira and son Kolya into adulthood. The couple hopes to finally live for themselves, but Marina finds out about her pregnancy. And that's at 55! In turn, Ira is already raising two children from her first marriage with her new husband, Semyon. The couple decide to go into business and open their own cheese shop, but it turns out that being sole proprietors is not so easy. As for Kolya, he's just getting married. However, the choice of the bride surprises everyone — the guy makes an offer to a housekeeper from Central Asia, Aida.
title: День семьи

overview: Survival Audition K-pop Star is a South Korean reality TV competition series where the three largest entertainment/talent agencies in South Korean hold worldwide auditions to find the next potential K-pop stars.
title: K-pop Star

overview: Big, Small, and Old are three stone gnomes who live in the front garden of No. 25 Telegraph Road. All three appear to lead such serene lives, Big fishing with his rod, Old fast asleep holding his spade, and Small feeding his frog all day. But their serenity is not all it might seem at first glance. Even stone gnomes can have trouble, trouble with the neighbours - especially when they are different.
title: The Gnomes of Dulwich

overview: Rylan Clark teams up with anthropologist Professor Alice Roberts to investigate one of the darkest and most harrowing chapters in British history - the murder of hundreds of women accused of witchcraft. Each episode centres on a specific witch trial, with Rylan and Alice opening a cold case into the stories behind some of the women accused of witchcraft during the 16th and 17th centuries, many of whom were found guilty and sentenced to death by hanging. They visit the towns and villages in Essex where the women lived and died. Guided by original court documents and a team of historians, psychologists and medical experts, they explore these women's lives, alleged crimes and trials.
title: Witches of Essex

overview: On their way from Egypt to the promised land, Moses and his family struggle to manage the hardest part of their nation's journey: the people.
title: The Promised Land

overview: Harlan Coben's Final Twist brings the top selling mystery author to true crime as he unravels murder cases to expose hidden truths.
title: Harlan Coben's Final Twist

overview: Docuseries about the shipwreck that shocked Brazil in 1988, a disaster marked by greed, negligence and impunity.
title: Bateau Mouche: O Naufrágio da Justiça

overview: Series following Love Island stars Olivia and Alex Bowen as they prepare for and welcome their second child into their family, navigating this new chapter while dealing with the emotional experience of losing one of their twins during a previous pregnancy.
title: Olivia and Alex: Parenthood

overview: Inspired by the chilling rediscovery of Ed Gein's original three-day police interrogation transcripts, this extraordinary two-part series brings to life one of America's most infamous true crime stories in a way never seen before. Ed Gein: Original Psycho is a chilling documentary that places viewers face-to-face with one of history's most disturbing killers, the man whose crimes inspired Psycho, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, and The Silence of the Lambs.
title: Ed Gein: Original Psycho

overview: The Equalizer follows a retired espionage/intelligence officer with a mysterious past, who uses the skills from his former career to exact vigilante justice on behalf of innocent people who are hopelessly trapped in dangerous circumstances.
title: The Equalizer

overview: The story follows Chen Hansheng, a military academy graduate who dreams of joining the special forces. Through unrelenting effort, he wins the recognition of Ling Zhengrong, acting commander of the Leopard unit, instructor Qiu Tian, and Zhang Lan, head of the repair squad. Finally admitted into the elite Leopard Assault Team, Chen Hansheng faces life-and-death trials alongside his teammates. Tempered by countless arduous missions, he evolves into a seasoned soldier, showcasing the passion and responsibility of a new-generation warrior forged through growth and sacrifice.
title: The Cheetah

overview: Adapted from Peng Laike's novel of the same name, set in a fictional chaotic world during the late Eastern Han Dynasty. The Wei and Qiao families are enemies due to past grievances. After the Qiao family's decline, they betray their eldest daughter and marry Xiao Qiao to Wei Shao. Wei Shao, harboring hatred for his father and brother's tragic deaths, coldly sends Xiao Qiao back to her hometown in Youzhou the day after their wedding. However, using memories from her past life and her own wisdom, Xiao Qiao overcomes the Wei family's difficulties and Empress Su E's repeated schemes. During times of crisis, she and Wei Shao support each other. Wei Shao is gradually moved by her gentleness and courage, lets go of his hatred, and begins pursuing his wife. Eventually, they work together to resolve their family conflicts. Wei Shao becomes emperor, Xiao Qiao becomes empress, and together they protect the peace of the realm.
title: To Bend the Waist

overview: A drama depicting the birth of an unusual family, thicker than blood and more tenacious than sperm.
title: Marie and Her Three Daddies

overview: Than, a single man who owns a fitness gym, suddenly has to take care of his niece, Nene, after his brother passes away unexpectedly. His life changes when he unexpectedly reunites with Akin, his former lover who disappeared years ago. They meet again when they bring their kids to the same school. Old memories resurface, and Than begins to search for the truth about why Akin vanished from his life.
title: Reloved

overview: In the post-Cold War world, particularly since 1953, the study of the human mind has been widely conducted to manage human resources. This includes the secret MK-Ultra project, as well as the ethical and freedom-of-thought issues of AI. It's undeniable that many organizations around the world are using it to exert power over humanitarian gains, choosing it as a "tool" to control reality, ultimately transforming humans into weapons more terrifying than any bomb. This prelude, in the form of interviews, will introduce you to the creators and actors involved in this sci-fi series, the inspiration behind the characters, and the experiences the actors have encountered along the way. It will make you question humanity, right and wrong, love, and hope. Perhaps we are being swayed by the mind control that permeates every part of our lives, leading us to re-examine whether we still own our own thoughts.
title: A(ir) Moment

overview: When teenager Theresa Bier mysteriously vanished in California's Sierra National Forest in 1987, a surprising suspect emerged: Bigfoot. Now, investigator Jessica Chobot and 29-year LAPD veteran Robert Collier reopen one of the most bizarre missing persons cases in modern history in hopes of bringing closure to Theresa's unsolved disappearance. Stranger than the lore that surrounds it, this mind-bending mystery compels the pair to reinvestigate the decades-old disappearance in search of new clues and evidence that may finally solve this unusual cold case once and for all. Interviewing witnesses who have never spoken publicly, exploring new photos, retracing Theresa's final moments, and digging into recently uncovered police reports about possible drug trafficking, serial killers and unspoken family drama, the duo unravels new theories about what may have happened on that fateful day. And why, amid all the evidence, people in her hometown accepted that Bigfoot was not just lore…but her murderer.
title: Bigfoot Took Her

overview: Callan was a late sixties-early seventies British action/drama television series created by James Mitchell. It starred Edward Woodward as Callan, an agent of a state secret service dealing with internal security threats to the United Kingdom.
title: Callan

overview: Song Zhi Wei's father had an affair when she was young. Her mother's health deteriorated day by day and she suffered from depression. She eventually committed suicide. Later on her father's mistress, Zhong Nian, became pregnant. She took advantage of the child to get ahead and excluded Song Zhi Wei. She used some of Song Zhi Wei's mother's things to stimulate her and started a dispute. During which, Zhong Nian deliberately fell down the stairs and falsely accused Song Zhi Wei of pushing her. This incident angered her father, who sent her abroad to study. Eight years later, Song Zhi Wei came back and deliberately approached her uncle-in-law for revenge. They already had an intersection five years earlier. Chu Han Ting knew that she was using him, but he was willing to be her pawn.
title: Stunner

overview: Wen Yan was a servant of the Chu family and Chu Shi Yu's nanny. She has been silently giving and handling everything for him. However, when Chu Shi Yu hurt her family, she decided to leave. When they met again, Wen Yan had become Fu Han Si's secretary. On a rainy night, Chu Shi Yu knelt down and begged Wen Yan to return, but Fu Han Si domineeringly declared his ownership of Wen Yan. The love between the two became more and more firm in the interweaving of power and emotion.
title: Ye Se Wen Rou

overview: Lin Wu tried her best to sleep with her future brother-in-law Xie Yan Shen. She was very ambitious and wanted him to submit to her, to avenge her stepmother and half sister, and to take back her mother's relics.
title: Long Coveted

overview: While studying abroad, Shu Yang met Qi Yan, an elite translator. Shu's father, intent on bringing them together, arranged for her to stay at Qi Yan's home. Over the course of four years, their relationship blossomed, but Qi Yan's half-brother threatened Shu Yang, leaving her emotionally wounded and kidnapped. She lost her memories. Qi Yan thought, "Let's wait, wait a little longer. Once he's dealt with all the unforeseen circumstances, he'll give Shu Yang the promise she desires." Four years later, Shu Yang and a friend opened a bar together. With cash running low, she received a marriage proposal from Qi Yan...
title: Spring Scenery Cannot Be Deceived

overview: Song Shuang Xu was abandoned by her parents at a young age. Shen Yu brought her home and raised her as a princess. She mistook dependence for love and was "exiled" abroad by the Shen family for many years. After returning to China, the Shen family was framed. She became He Ting Zhou's secret lover to repay the favor, but she didn't know that he had been secretly in love with her for many years. His meticulous care made her understand what true love is.
title: The Fiery Young Marshal

overview: Qiao Xin Ran lives a very difficult life, even working as a food delivery person, to pay for her mother-in-law's medical treatment. One day, while on a delivery, she makes a shocking discovery: her husband, Liang Yu Xuan, is actually the wealthy heir to the Liang family. At the same time, she sees him proposing to his first love. Devastated, she decides to get a divorce. The president of the Chu Corporation, Chu Ming Yi, offers help and invites her to join his company. Meanwhile, Liang Yu Xuan continues to harass and bother her. During a company celebration, Qiao Xinran tries to prove her worth and establish herself, but she is obstructed and sabotaged by Liang Yu Xuan and his new partner, Anna.
title: East of Eden

overview: The Sandbaggers is a British television drama series about men and women on the front lines of the Cold War.
title: The Sandbaggers

overview: A delivery man and a high society widow open a hostel for immigrants-forgetting to hang the sign that says 'No Drama Allowed.' They face more secrets than beds, a romance hotter than their free Wi-Fi, and a neighborhood determined to shut them down.
title: Sin frenos

overview: A docuseries that follows five extraordinary Flemish people in miraculous situations and encounters, where they discover a mysterious world of extrasensory phenomena that current science deems impossible.
title: Paranormaal Vlaanderen

overview: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story tells the story of how one young woman changed what the world believed a killer could be... all it took was an axe. When the repressed daughter of a wealthy New England family and her rebellious maid find themselves trapped in a house built on humiliation and cruelty, they escape into a fantasy of sex, power, and revenge. The gruesome unsolved murders that follow don't just shock the world—they give birth to an icon who refuses to live imprisoned in a cage, choosing instead to forge her own legend: shocking, monstrous, and gloriously free.
title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story

overview: Working for a company specializing in breaking up in-office romances, Rei Saegusa infiltrates an event-planning firm to target a toxic workplace affair.
title: Affair ender REI

overview: Special Branch is a British television series made by Thames Television for ITV and shown between 1969 and 1974. Special Branch was a police drama series, centred on members of the Special Branch anti-espionage and anti-terrorist department of the London Metropolitan Police.
title: Special Branch

overview: Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning Ticket (commonly called BNW) were scheduled to run in the "G1 Osaka Hai," but had lost their motivation to race. Concerned, the student council organized the "BNW Ekiden" at the Fan Appreciation Festival — a relay where 7 runners per team pass a sash — hoping to inspire the three to rally. The members, including Special Week, are tasked with persuading them, but struggle to get through. They wish for the trio to rekindle the passionate friendship they had around the Derby… Meanwhile, at the festival, the "Can Oguri Cap eat 1,000 bowls of wanko soba?" show is held at the same time! This 3-part OVA continues right after season 1 of Uma Musume: Pretty Derby and was included with the fourth volume of Uma Musume: Pretty Derby blu-ray release.
title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - BNW no Chikai

overview: Road to the Top delves into the lives of newer-generation Uma Musume, focusing on their challenges, growth, and aspirations in the competitive world of racing. The series highlights the journey of these characters as they strive to make a name for themselves, facing both internal and external obstacles. Through their stories, the anime explores themes of perseverance, teamwork, and the pursuit of dreams.
title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Road to the Top

overview: This 2 night special takes off during their graduation, where Chiaki-senpai & Nodame left for Europe. The first special centered on Chiaki's story, the story tells about Chiaki's dream to be a conductor. Nodame on the other hand attended the conservatory to attain her dream to one-day play the piano for Chiaki. After her hard work, Nodame was given a chance to have a mini recital. During the recital, Chiaki saw her worth and realized that he cannot go on with out her.
title: Nodame Cantabile in Europe
